name: Ashiok
description: Ashiok is a nightmare-weaving planeswalker of unknown gender and origin who draws on fear and dreams to make nightmares real.

description_citations.text: "Ashiok". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Ashiok is a nightmare-weaving planeswalker of unknown gender and origin who draws on fear and dreams to make nightmares real.

citations.text: "Ashiok". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: On Theros, Ashiok bargained with Phenax and, posing as the advisor Udaen, sent nightmare creatures to a peace meeting so that the leonin destroyed Iretis.

citations.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Ashiok's tampering with citizens' dreams created the god Cacophony, whom Ephara quickly slew.

citations.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

bio.text: Ashiok later tormented Elspeth in the Underworld with nightmares, until she lodged the Shadowspear in Ashiok's chest and Ashiok planeswalked away.

citations.text: "Ashiok", section "Beyond Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth
citations.text: "Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth", section "Volume 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On New Phyrexia Ashiok disrupted a compleation to trick Elesh Norn, and in A Garden of Flesh admitted creating a nightmare as art to test whether a Phyrexian mind could be afraid.

citations.text: "Ashiok", section "On New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

bio.text: On Eldraine Ashiok used sleepers' nightmares against the awake and allied with Eriette, until Kellan restrained Ashiok and Will struck them with an ice bolt, forcing them to planeswalk away.

citations.text: "Ashiok", section "On Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ashiok", section "On Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citations.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

bio.text: Later, on Thunder Junction, the Ashiok who hired Oko's crew for the Maag Taranau heist turned out to be Jace Beleren wearing an illusion of Ashiok.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.
"Ashiok", section "Impersonation on Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: The real Ashiok has not been shown since leaving Eldraine, and in 2026 Ajani only wonders whether Ashiok might be behind Chandra's visions.

citations.text: "Ashiok", section "On Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Dack learns he will be affected by the Sleep Curse and enters Theros's Underworld.
timeline.quote: was last seen entering a portal to Theros's Underworld

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leonin destroy Iretis through the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax.
timeline.quote: Destroyed by leonin thanks to the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax

citation.text: "Oreskos", section "Locations in Oreskos's surroundings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phenax makes a pact with Ashiok to lay waste to Iretis in exchange for hiding Ashiok from the other gods.
timeline.quote: Phenax made a pact with the nightmare planeswalker Ashiok

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Cooperation with Ashiok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok and Phenax plague Iretis and the leonin with nightmares until the leonin destroy the polis; Phenax claims it as a necropolis.
timeline.quote: Phenax then claimed Iretis as a new necropolis for his Returned.

citation.text: "Returned", section "Iretis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, empowered by Ashiok, escapes the Underworld to assassinate Heliod.
timeline.quote: Elspeth became empowered by Ashiok , who equipped her with a weapon created from her past traumas

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's nightmares torment Elspeth; in one vision she seizes Heliod's spear Khrusor and a twisted version remains.
timeline.quote: in one of them, Elspeth seized Heliod's spear, Khrusor.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The old man's illusion fades and reveals Ashiok.
timeline.quote: the old man's form began to waver and shimmer.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reads the king's letters and saves them from the fire.
timeline.quote: Ashiok held the letters above the fire for a second, then stopped and brought them back, undamaged, to lay on the desk.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax confronts Ashiok about the deaths; Ashiok admits the story was invented but the family may die on the road.
timeline.quote: The story of their deaths I made up.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax warns Ashiok to show respect.
timeline.quote: Presume with me again, and I will erase you from existence.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reports that the leonin are sacking Iretis and that the city now belongs to Phenax.
timeline.quote: The leonin sacking of the city has already begun.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax asks Ashiok what boon is wanted; Ashiok reveals a love of making nightmares real.
timeline.quote: I have built a beautiful dream here in Iretis.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok whispers a request to Phenax, who is surprised.
timeline.quote: You are sure, mortal? This is what you want?

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax looks into Ashiok's essence, laughs, grants the wish and leaves.
timeline.quote: So be it, mortal. You shall have your wish.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok comes to Theros drawn by the power of mortals' belief and the darker side of belief, nightmares.
timeline.quote: Ashiok came to Theros because of the strong power of devotion and belief of the plane's mortals

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok bargains with Phenax and seeks to incite war between Iretis and the leonin.
timeline.quote: they made a bargain with Phenax , the god of lies and deceit

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Posing as Udaen, Ashiok sends nightmare abominations to kill people at a peace meeting; the leonin annihilate Iretis, serving Phenax's plan, and Ashiok asks to be made invisible to the gods.
timeline.quote: The leonin retaliated by annihilating the Iretis' citizenry

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's experiment of disturbing citizens' dreams creates the god Cacophony, whom Ephara quickly slays.
timeline.quote: The newborn god was quickly slain by Ephara

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok, whose concealment from Phenax's boon fades, reveals that they sculpted the dreams to create the god Cacophony as a display, hiding in an abandoned Ephara temple.
timeline.quote: The earth's rumbles faded to stillness as the last remnant of Phenax's glamour dissolved around Ashiok.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Ashiok recalls repaying a favor to Phenax with a boon to hide from the gods, and Phenax's warning not to use it to harm a god.
timeline.quote: The boon was a temporary one, and Phenax had been very explicit about Ashiok's fate if Ashiok used the boon to attempt to injure or murder a god.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reflects that turning an idea into a god is easy compared to Xenagos's feat, and that Cacophony could rise again.
timeline.quote: But turning an idea into a god was much easier.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's nightmares spread, causing magic users to wake with no memory of what they did and be cast out as Ashiok gathers power.
timeline.quote: Ashiok gathered power for the grandest spell

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "A grander scheme". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok plans a Sleep curse over all Theros but Dack, Ravos and the dead put an end to it.
timeline.quote: Dack, Ravos , and the dead put an end to Ashiok's Sleep curse.

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "A grander scheme". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kedarick sends his advisor Udaen, secretly Ashiok, to broker the peace treaty.
timeline.quote: Kedarick sent his advisor Udaen to broker the treaty

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thoros offers support for peace, then pulls his nephew's head from his satchel blaming the leonin, and lunges at Kedarick; Kedarick beheads him.
timeline.quote: Thoros himself was beheaded by Kedarick, his former friend.

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the treaty signing, nightmare creatures appear and kill leonin elders and Kedarick's bodyguards.
timeline.quote: The bodyguard Chelta stabbed the monster's chest

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A leonin army marches on Iretis; Ashiok falsely tells Kedarick his wife and child were murdered, and Kedarick stabs out his own eyes.
timeline.quote: Kedarick drew his dagger and stabbed himself first in one eye, then the other

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals themself as mastermind; Phenax claims Iretis for his Returned.
timeline.quote: Phenax would have the city to house his Returned

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nightmares begin manifesting on Eldraine as a consequence of Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber, often taking the shape of the Phyrexian invaders.
timeline.quote: Nightmares began manifesting on Eldraine as a consequence of Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber .

citation.text: "Nightmare", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok savors Elspeth's twisted dreams and learns of the Phyrexians, then is speared by Elspeth's Shadowspear and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: After being speared by Elspeth's Shadowspear , Ashiok planeswalked away

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Beyond Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth pulls Heliod's spear from a nightmare, turning it into Shadowspear.
timeline.quote: Elspeth pulled Heliod's spear, Khrusor

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Beyond death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's actions cause nightmares to manifest in reality on Theros.
timeline.quote: As a consequence of the actions of Ashiok, Nightmares manifested in reality on Theros .

citation.text: "Nightmare", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norn realizes the world is a dream-like illusion and names the planeswalker Ashiok.
timeline.quote: Scowling, she whispered, "Ashiok."

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok appears, admits to creating the nightmare as art and testing whether a Phyrexian mind can be afraid.
timeline.quote: I was not certain Phyrexians would be suitable for my art.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals a head of Elspeth Tirel in the garden, saying they first encountered her on Theros and sought her in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: "Her name is Elspeth Tirel."

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn rejects Ashiok, summoning dream Phyrexians from her own will and declaring that they are one.
timeline.quote: "We are one," Norn said.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: The nightmare garden merges into creatures that attack, and Phyrexians and Norn cut them down.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians surged forward, slicing through the dream manifestations

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok shapes a nightmare Elspeth in the mirror of Norn's form, which frightens Norn before she slays it.
timeline.quote: she flung it into the nightmare version of Elspeth Tirel

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok flees, the nightmare dissolves and Norn is left shaken by the pity in the false Elspeth's eyes.
timeline.quote: She looked at Norn with such human pity

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's letter recounts how Elspeth and a prisoner called Boy tried to hide among corpses in a Phyrexian asylum on New Capenna; Boy was caught and Phyrexianized.
timeline.quote: Thanks to your Planeswalker spark, you escaped, but Boy wasn't as fortunate.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: On New Phyrexia Ashiok tricks Elesh Norn with a fake failed compleation; Norn attacks and Ashiok leaves behind an Elspeth figure in Norn's armor.
timeline.quote: making it appear as if her glistening oil failed to properly compleat a Mirran woman

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "On New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norn tries to compleat a Mirran woman, but the compleation fails because of a nightmare produced by Ashiok; Norn vows to kill Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Enraged, Norn vowed she would kill Elspeth

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Meeting Ashiok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rowan is swept into a waltz of slumbering knights and met by Ashiok in the Court of the Ardent Queen.
timeline.quote: "Welcome to the Court of the Ardent Queen, Rowan Kenrith."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok leads Rowan to Eriette, who says she brought her there because she admires Rowan's fire.
timeline.quote: "Dear Rowan, I brought you here because I admire the fire within you."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Eriette explains she created the Wicked Slumber to protect her people from the invaders, and Ashiok conjures an illusion of Rowan's parents.
timeline.quote: When she opens her eyes again her parents are standing at the woman's side.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok says Rowan's spark is gone, and Eriette welcomes Rowan as her heir; Rowan accepts her embrace.
timeline.quote: "My name is Eriette, darling. Welcome home."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok returns and takes control of the sleepers, turning the battle against Will's knights.
timeline.quote: Veils of black coalesce into Ashiok's elegant form before the gathered army.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan lashes Ashiok in place with his golden whip so Will can strike them with a bolt of ice, which makes Ashiok vanish.
timeline.quote: Ashiok lets out a howl of pain as the ice spreads through their body.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok frees Eriette from her cell, promising her new land far away, and she vanishes.
timeline.quote: "Opportunity calls us in a new direction.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: On sleeping Eldraine Ashiok turns sleepers' nightmares against the awake and allies with Eriette.
timeline.quote: They allied with the witch Eriette , one of the authors of the curse.

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "On Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Castle Ardenvale Kellan restrains Ashiok and Will strikes them with an ice bolt, forcing them to planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: struck in the chest by an ice bolt from Will, forcing them to planeswalk to safety

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "On Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan helps Will Kenrith subdue Ashiok at Castle Ardenvale so Eriette is captured, though Rowan escapes.
timeline.quote: Kellan helped Will subdue the planeswalker

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok and Eriette tell Rowan of her lost spark and family tie; she joins her aunt, and fights Will, who defeats Ashiok and captures Eriette while Rowan escapes.
timeline.quote: Will was able to defeat Ashiok with the help of Kellan and Ruby

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok arrives on Eldraine to profit from the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: Ashiok has arrived to profit from the Wicked Slumber nobody can wake up from

citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Will wins Imodane's fealty, assaults Castle Ardenvale, defeats Ashiok with Kellan and Ruby, and captures Eriette, ending the Wicked Slumber; Rowan escapes into the Wilds.
timeline.quote: capture the witch Eriette , ending the Wicked Slumber.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, with Vraska and disguised as Ashiok, uses Oko to assemble a team to break into Maag Taranau, wakes the child in stasis and leaves with it.
timeline.quote: Jace and Vraska left the other members of the team and disappeared with the child

citation.text: "Coin Empire", section "Heist of Maag Taranau". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok appears and explains they hired the crew to break into the vault, which Akul built the town of Tarnation around.
timeline.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built an entire town around the vault hoping to control it.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan recognizes Ashiok, says they attacked his home and made Rowan Kenrith turn evil, but Oko tells him to trust him instead.
timeline.quote: They made Rowan Kenrith turn—well, evil!

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: At a camp after the escape, Ashiok extracts memories from the captured Outcaster Nolan.
timeline.quote: Memories were pulled out of Nolan's mind, leaving streaks of silver threads in the air.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reports that the artifact is one of six keys, Akul holds the other five in a medallion, and a map to Tarnation is buried in Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: Akul has the other five. He wears them in a medallion around his neck

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie shoots Oko, purposely missing, and Kellan uses his fae magic as Ashiok's nightmares overwhelm them.
timeline.quote: Shadows moved across the floor, wrapping around not only Kellan but Annie and Ral, too.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko uses the key to open the vault door and enters the treasure vault.
timeline.quote: With the back of his hand, Oko wiped the blood from his chin, and stepped into the treasure vault.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's illusion drops, revealing Jace Beleren, who puts Annie to sleep.
timeline.quote: The darkness evaporated, and beneath Ashiok's hooded cloak was Jace Beleren.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Twelve months earlier, Jace wears an illusion of Ashiok to break Eriette out of a jail on Eldraine.
timeline.quote: Jace as Ashiok smiles without eyes and curls his fingers around the bars of her cell.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace uses Ashiok's image as a cover identity to recruit a raiding team for Maag Taranau, first freeing Eriette.
timeline.quote: The first use of this cover identity was to free Eriette from prison and recruit her.

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Impersonation on Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko lets Kellan join his gang, where he is shocked to see Eriette and Ashiok.
timeline.quote: Oko decided to let Kellan join his gang

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok paralyzes Kellan; the one who takes the treasure is revealed to be Jace in disguise and Oko planeswalks away from Vraska.
timeline.quote: revealing themself to be Jace Beleren in disguise

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok hires Oko for a heist of Maag Taranau, and they gather an outlaw crew.
timeline.quote: he was contacted by Ashiok and hired to perform a heist to steal the contents of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok paralyzes Kellan and Oko opens the vault, but Ashiok is revealed to be Jace in disguise; Oko planeswalks away from Vraska's gaze.
timeline.quote: Oko was only just able to planeswalk away before being petrified by Vraska's gaze.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok is revealed to be Jace Beleren, who planeswalks away without paying the gang.
timeline.quote: they revealed themself to be Jace Beleren under an illusion and planeswalked away without paying the gang

citation.text: "Satoru Umezawa", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, disguised as Ashiok, shatters the pod and frees Loot, then disappears with Loot and Vraska.
timeline.quote: He pressed both hands to the glass, and the pod shattered.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Maag Taranau". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani wonders whether Chandra's visions might be Ashiok's work and descends behind her.
timeline.quote: It could be Ashiok planting these images in her head.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
